description: This file defines the JsonParser class used for parsing JSON responses within the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles different shape types such as structure, list, map, timestamp, and blob, converting JSON data into corresponding PHP data structures.

classes.name: JsonParser
classes.description: A class implementing standard JSON parsing for AWS API responses.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a given shape from a JSON value, handling different data types accordingly.
